title: ChasePlayers
description: This mod adds some uncontrollable player entity. they can throw potions, TNTs, place cobblestones etc.
body:
**Fun with some players chasing you.**

# MOB
**Player (Entity)**
**Ability** 
- Throws Ender Pearls
- Throws Splash Potions like witchs
- Throws TNTs
- Place Cobblestones under their location
- Destroy Blocks

**Spawn**
- Naturally Spawn
- Command : /summon chase_player:player ~ ~ ~
